result.brief: 提出 ReSeed：仅在蒸馏学生模型第一步加轻量种子响应偏置适配器并对齐教师首段割线速度，冻结其余权重，恢复少步扩散采样的多样性，并在文生图与 Wan2.1 文生视频上验证。
result.reason: Post-distillation adapter restoring diversity in few-step diffusion, evaluated on text-to-image and text-to-video (Wan2.1) models; directly serves video/image generation efficiency and sampling.
